provenance.method: Generated for structcorpus from YAML 1.2.2 sections 5.7 and 7.3.1 and the published yamlprims specification revision 1.1, section 4.1; each escape's decoded text is written out by hand.

review.author: devlead
review.rationale: Every YAML 1.2.2 double-quoted escape, alone and inside text; escaped line breaks; escape-only scalars whose encoded and decoded lengths differ, up to 4 KiB; and every proper prefix of each hex escape, a non-hex digit inside one, undefined escape letters, and a backslash at end of input, all syntax errors.
